final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student s WHERE s.StuID IN (SELECT h.StuID FROM Has_Pet h JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID=h.PetID WHERE p.PetType='dog') AND s.StuID NOT IN (SELECT h.StuID FROM Has_Pet h JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID=h.PetID WHERE p.PetType='cat') LIMIT 100
answer:
One student has a dog but no cat: **Tracy, age 19**.

I matched students to pets through the `Has_Pet` table and took the pet type from `Pets.PetType`, using the values 'dog' and 'cat'. I excluded any student who has a cat, even if they also have a dog.
